package.name: amr_2wheel_robot
package.description: 2-wheeled AMR (Autonomous Mobile Robot) built on WooDriveSdk. Stage 1: left/right WooDrive dual-axis control foundation (individual enable/disable and speed commands, safety watchdog). Robot-specific -- depends on core/ directly (the same SDK woodrive_ros2 uses), not on the woodrive_ros2 package. No /cmd_vel, kinematics, odometry, or TF yet -- see the package README.
